_comment: Derived by scripts/build_ability_moves.py from the move and ability text. Do not hand-edit; re-run it instead.

Sheer Force.why: +30% power, and the secondary is lost

Hustle.why: +50% physical damage, but accuracy drops to 80%

Adaptability.why: STAB x2.0 instead of x1.5, on a move of the user's own type

Skill Link.why: always 5 hits - accuracy is rolled once for the lot

Contrary.why_up: this BOOST becomes a drop - Contrary inverts it
Contrary.why_down: this DROP becomes a boost - Contrary inverts it

Multiscale.why: damage taken halved at full HP

Defiant.why: +2 Attack whenever one of ITS OWN stats is dropped

Competitive.why: +2 Sp. Atk whenever one of ITS OWN stats is dropped

Mega Sol.why: the user's moves are treated as being in sun: Fire boosted, Water weakened, and no rain penalty

Liquid Voice.why: sound move, so it lands as Water-type

Flash Fire.why: +50% once a Fire move has hit it - which it is immune to

Electromorphosis.why: charged by taking a hit: the next Electric move is boosted

Fairy Aura.why: +33% on every Fairy move in play, both sides

Stakeout.why: double damage on a Pokemon that just switched in

Supreme Overlord.why: +10% Attack and Sp. Atk for each ally already fainted

Rivalry.why: +25% against the same gender, -25% against the opposite

Huge Power.why: Attack doubled - a stat, so the BP does not change

Pure Power.why: Attack doubled - a stat, so the BP does not change

Guts.why: Attack +50% while statused, and burn's own Attack drop is ignored

Solar Power.why: Sp. Atk x1.5 in sun, at 1/8 max HP a turn

Plus.why: Sp. Atk +50% while an ally has Plus or Minus

Minus.why: Sp. Atk +50% while an ally has Plus or Minus

No Guard.why: cannot miss - and neither can anything aimed at it

Merciless.why: always a critical hit against a poisoned target

Stench.why: a chance to make the target flinch

Prankster.why: +1 priority - and it fails outright against a Dark-type

Gale Wings.why: +1 priority at full HP - Tailwind and Roost included

Protean.why: the user becomes this move's type before it goes off, once per switch-in - so everything gets STAB

Libero.why: the user becomes this move's type before it goes off, once per switch-in - so everything gets STAB

Stalwart.why: ignores opposing abilities and redirection - Lightning Rod and Follow Me do not pull it

Infiltrator.why: goes through Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen and Safeguard

Long Reach.why: no contact is made: Rough Skin, Static and Rocky Helmet never fire

Piercing Drill.why: hits through Protect, for a quarter of the damage

Rock Head.why: no recoil - the drawback is simply gone

Magician.why: it takes the target's held item

Stance Change.why: attacking flips it to Blade Forme first - 140 Attack, not the Shield spread's 50

Heatproof.why: Fire damage halved, and so is burn chip

Purifying Salt.why: Ghost damage halved, and no status at all

Fluffy.why: contact halved - but Fire doubled, both at once on a Fire contact move

Dry Skin.why: Water heals it instead of hurting; Fire hurts more

Eelevate.why: it floats: damaging Ground moves do nothing

Lightning Rod.why: drawn to it, does no damage, and gives it +1 Sp. Atk

Thermal Exchange.why: +1 Attack, and it cannot be burned

Liquid Ooze.why: the drain is reversed - the attacker loses that HP

Good as Gold.why: a foe's status move does nothing to it

Magic Bounce.why: bounced straight back at whoever used it

Armor Tail.why: an opponent cannot use it against this Pokemon or its ally

Queenly Majesty.why: an opponent cannot use it against this Pokemon or its ally

Cursed Body.why: 30% chance the move is disabled once it hits

Magic Guard.why: only a direct attack hurts it - no hazards, weather, burn, poison or Leech Seed

Telepathy.why: an ALLY's spread move does nothing to it

Mirror Armor.why: the drop is bounced back at whoever used it

Hyper Cutter.why: its Attack cannot be lowered by a foe

Rough Skin.why: 1/8 of the attacker's max HP back at it

Aftermath.why: if this is the finishing hit, the attacker loses 1/4 of its max HP

Effect Spore.why: 10% chance of paralysis, poison or sleep on the attacker

Innards Out.why: if this is the finishing hit, the attacker loses whatever HP was left

Toxic Debris.why: poison spikes are scattered on the attacker's side

Aroma Veil.why: it and its ally are protected from this

Grass Pelt.why: Defense x1.5 while Grassy Terrain is up

Insomnia.why: it cannot be put to sleep

Vital Spirit.why: it cannot be put to sleep

Sweet Veil.why: neither it nor its ally can be put to sleep

Leaf Guard.why: in sun, no status lands on it at all

Flower Veil.why: a Grass-type ally cannot be statused by this

Synchronize.why: whatever this inflicts is passed straight back

Corrosion.why: this poisons even a Steel or Poison type
